method: conversational owner decision in the written task instructions for the Hmong Orpheus local trial

D1.subject: Llama 3.2 Community License and Acceptable Use Policy
D1.statement: I have personally reviewed the Llama 3.2 Community License and Acceptable Use Policy, and I accept them for local research inference with the Hmong Orpheus checkpoint.

D2.subject: Local trials of Pakorn2112/Orpheus-TTS-hmong-3b
D2.statement: The card's Apache-2.0 research/educational label, together with D1, is enough for local trials at the pinned revision.
D2.output_handling: Outputs stay outside Git and are not shared.

D3.subject: One-time SNAC pickle-to-safetensors conversion
D3.permitted_method: torch.load(..., weights_only=True) inside an isolated throwaway environment; no full unpickling and no weights_only=False fallback
D3.after_conversion: Load only from the pinned safetensors file.
D3.if_rejected: Stop that route and document the result.

D4.subject: Other candidates
D4.hmong_f5: Remains blocked: the checkpoint has no license.
D4.yuhalu: Remains blocked: requires payment and EULA acceptance.
D4.permitted_follow_up: One quick check for any change in their terms.

D5.subject: Commit and push
D5.statement: If the work finishes validated, commit and push to rescope/audited-tts-workbench, including the reviewed September 28 work.

D6.subject: Contacting people
D6.statement: Never post, send, or open a discussion or issue. Drafts for the owner to send and reading public pages are permitted.

not_covered: public or commercial use of the checkpoint, its outputs or a hosted service
redistribution of Orpheus, SNAC or converted weights
any claim of White Hmong language quality
